subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Know the sequence of months of the year; place birthdays on a calendar

show.line: A year has twelve months. January, February, March, April, May, June. July, August, September, October, November, December!

rounds.prompt: January, February, March. Which month comes next?
Which month is the first month of the year?
Which month comes after June? Say the month.
September, October, November. Which month comes next?
rounds.praise: December! The last month of the year.

rounds.prompt: Which month is the last month of the year?
Count the months on the calendar. How many months in a year?

rounds.story: Thabo's birthday is in the month after March. In which month is Thabo's birthday?
rounds.praise: April! The month after March is April.

hints: Say the months song from January. Stop at the one you need.
December is last. January is first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the months after April.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I skipped June. April, May, June, July.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say them together. April, May, June, July!

parent_line: Can say the months of the year in order.
